clues: Its rock formed from cooling lava roughly 50 to 60 million years ago.
Around 40,000 interlocking, mostly hexagonal stone columns make up this place.
In 1986 it became Northern Ireland's only UNESCO World Heritage Site.
It lies on the Antrim coast, a short drive from the Bushmills distillery.
Legend says Finn McCool built it as a path across the sea to Scotland.
